lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-intensity circular spots in staggered vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with a discernible triangular cluster of three primary spots in the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spots to form a grid-like pattern, particularly evident in the mid-to-upper flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear horizontal feature runs across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-luminance teleost (remora) attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin; cranial region displays a transition to a high-density vermiculate spot pattern.
